explanation: A title used to refer to God as the supreme authority and ruler over all.
Persons or forces that oppose or work against God's will and plan.
A moral quality that involves acting in accordance with God's laws and principles.
The day when God will judge all people based on their deeds and faith, granting them eternal reward or punishment.
Support or assistance that God gives to those who seek Him and trust in His protection and guidance.
To give solace and relief to those who suffer or are in distress, often through God's love and care.
A person or power that protects and stands up for the weak, innocent, and oppressed, often a reference to God Himself.
An expression of gratitude, reverence, and worship toward God through song, prayer, or other forms of artistic expression.
